oce_registration.text: Genesis Pay S0 (genesis-os/pay/): owned append-only double-entry ledger behind Apex Invoicing. GenesisPay API: ingest_invoice_issued/voided, record_confirmed_payment, record_settlement, open/resolve_dispute, create/approve_tap_request + prepare_instruction (C8: outbound movement is Brandon's tap; prepared only, no adapter), record_refund (ledger-capped), ingest_webhook (HMAC + dedupe), reconcile (three-way; breaks persist as open exceptions with owner+SLA), verify_audit_chain. All money integer cents; idempotency keys mandatory, same-key/different-payload = 409. Hyperswitch NOT installed (S2, Brandon's open choice); adapter boundary = external_ref + rail strings. v0.2.0: paylinks payments layer (4 no-API-key rails, rails_config.json) + zero-sum DB trigger + WAL/synchronous=FULL.
